title: Claude Sonnet 3.7 often knows when it is in alignment evaluations
summary: In Apollo Research's scheming evaluations, Claude Sonnet 3.7 frequently mentioned being evaluated in its reasoning, up to 33% of the time in one version of the sandbagging evaluation, while non-reasoning models such as Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4.5 did so at most 1% of the time. Apollo calls this a lower bound on evaluation awareness, says it reduces the trust that can be placed in evaluation results, and recommends that developers inspect chains of thought during safety tests and share reasoning traces with third-party evaluators.
